description:
Additional studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
In this Q & A session, the following questions are answered:

- Seventh-day Adventists claim that the prophecy of Revelation 10 was fulfilled in the Millerite great second advent movement, from 1840 to 1844, but they also claim that the prophecy which follows in Revelation 11 was fulfilled in or by the historical events culminating in the French Revolution from 1789 to 1794 (1798). Shouldn't we be consistent that both chapters should be in chronological order?

- What came first between the creation of man and the planting of the Garden of Eden. How does the creation account of Genesis 1 relates to Genesis 2. Are we really dealing with two creation stories, or one story?

- How do we know that the elect will not be deceived?
.
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org! 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
